title: Dr Frost Arctic Coconut Lemonade Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Coconut Lemonade Ice pairs the smooth, creamy notes of Coconut with the bright, zesty sparkle of Lemonade, finished with a crisp menthol exhale. This exotic and refreshing blend delivers a uniquely balanced flavour profile, perfect for vapers seeking bold, layered combinations of fruit and menthol. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour, delivering the same bold, intense taste found in disposable vapes. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Coconut Lemonade Ice is designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Coconut Lemonade Ice offers a versatile choice for adult smokers and vapers looking for exotic and refreshing flavours.
